item.title: Agree on challenge changes together
item.summary: Propose a new challenge schedule, duration or start date, and agree to it together in your chat with Murph.
item.details: Murph reuses your shared chat or starts one with both players. The current schedule stays in place until the other player agrees. Changes affect future days, keeping the check-ins and missed days already recorded. Available for supported two-player challenges with verified phone numbers.
